---
name: Feature Request
about: Propose a capability or product direction for Aaroh
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: ['enhancement', 'needs-triage']
assignees: ''
---

> Aaroh is at Stage 0 — Pre-Development. Nothing has been decided yet, so proposals
> at this stage genuinely shape the product.

## Summary

A concise description of what you are proposing.

## Problem Being Solved

What problem does a student actually have here? Describe the situation, the constraint, and the decision they are struggling to make.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the capability as specifically as you can.

## Transparency Check

Aaroh must be able to explain its recommendations.

- How would a student see *why* Aaroh produced this output?
- What inputs would the explanation reference?

## Constraint Awareness

- Which real student constraints does this account for (time, deadlines, current level, competing commitments)?

## Alternatives Considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why this one?

## Impact Assessment

- **Breaking change?** Yes / No
- **Version bump required?** PATCH / MINOR / MAJOR
